structured.feedback: Shippable. At about 230 words it meets the length, Markdown, subheading, call-to-action, no-link and no-quote rules. Each feature is paired with its benefit, and it avoids claiming the mask protects against germs or droplets. Small issues: it repeats "comfortable" and "lightweight" a few times, and it never uses the keyword "mask". "Holds its shape wash after wash" also overstates durability, since one review says the masks fray after about twelve wears.
